coordinates: three.js metres, +Y up; interior x -5.25..7.6, z -3.6..3.6, floor y 0, ceiling y 3.2 (coffer recess rises to y 3.5 above the table)

materials.baked_unlit: KHR_materials_unlit, baseColorTexture is the full baked radiance (sRGB JPEG)
materials.emissive: black base colour, emissiveFactor holds the light colour at strength 1; boost emissiveIntensity for bloom
materials.glass: placeholder material, intended to be overridden

bake.denoiser: OpenImageDenoise (compositor) on the lighting bake, with baked normals
bake.tone: linear below 0.62, exponential shoulder capped at 0.93, before sRGB encoding

sky.source: Poly Haven sunset_jhbcentral (CC0), tonemapped JPG downscaled to 4096x2048
sky.note: three.js equirect lookup: u = atan2(dir.z, dir.x)/(2 pi) + 0.5, so -X samples u = 0 by default; scene.backgroundRotation.y = pi + 2 pi (u - 0.5) brings u onto -X (derived from the shader maths; check visually).

exposure_notes: Render the room meshes with MeshBasicMaterial (map, sRGB colour space). Values are at or below about 0.93 and mostly below 0.6, so NeutralToneMapping at exposure 1.0 leaves them almost unchanged; toneMapped false is also fine.
Realtime lights only need to light characters and props; the room ignores them.
Daylight is a cool overcast twilight from the window side; warm 2700K pendant, amber cove, amber wall wash on the slats and amber line under the front wall brass rail.

screen_recess.note: flat dark graphite panel at z -3.62; slat fronts are at z -3.60

sources.procedural: graphite and brushed brass are procedural noise materials
